page.layout: One page of text in a single column, centred on the page; below the text a printed ornament (fleuron). No running head, no page number, no margin notes.

main_text.l: Quia Idea Dei tantam realitatem objectivam in
se continet, ut illam mens nostra non nisi à
solo Deo realiter existente potuerit accipere,
A Dei sive Entis summè perfecti existentia o-
pendet, adeò ut, nisi sciamus Deum existe-
re, ne quidem certò scire possimus ter tria esse
Mens nostra solâ voluntate potest movere cor-
Id quod imago quaedam divinæ potentiæ est: Deus

page.notes: The ornament below FINIS is a printer's fleuron, not transcribed. The page is a numbered list of theses (V–VIII) set in italic type; the numerals are kept as printed in the body as headings. Long s is rendered as s throughout.
